name: RetNet
notes: RetNet is an architecture paper record (arXiv:2307.08621), not a released checkpoint: no config.json, no served weights, and no softmax KV cache. The KV-geometry fields are undefined for retention and left null. Retentive Network (RetNet) per arXiv:2307.08621. Three equivalent paradigms: parallel (training), recurrent (O(1) inference), and chunkwise recurrent (long sequences). The recurrent form gives O(1) per-token inference cost. 'Favourable scaling results, parallel training, low-cost deployment, and efficient inference' (no numeric speedup in abstract). Very often cited as ICLR 2024 but OpenReview forum returns venueid='ICLR.cc/2024/' suggesting rejection. Research-only adoption. [ID renamed from 'retnet-retentive-network' to 'retnet-arch' to avoid collision with papers/retnet-retentive-network. Source fixed from non-existent 'retnet' to 'pap-arch-2307-08621'.]
